- Use case: real-time clinical note summarization (short-form PHI) inside HavenHealth clinician portal.
- Traffic profile: pilot ~50k tokens/day, projection 1m tokens/day in 12 months.
- Primary concerns: HIPAA/BAA, audit evidence (SOC2), data residency / VPC isolation for PHI.

Immediate asks we agreed on
1) Confirm whether HavenHealth requires a full Private (VPC or on-prem) deployment for pilot, or if Dedicated capacity with BAA is acceptable.
2) You requested SOC2 evidence and a starting BAA draft — attaching both items.
3) We will follow up with a short hosting tradeoffs doc (latency/cost/security) and an engineering feasibility note for Private on-prem install.

Next steps
- I will send the hosting tradeoffs spreadsheet and a proposed M.A.P. by EOD tomorrow. (Action: me)

SOC2 / KMS
- The SOC2-type2 we provided includes control mappings for encryption at rest and in transit, and lists our KMS partner (CloudKMS Inc.) in Appendix B. I've attached a short annotated summary (one-pager) that pulls the KMS lifecycle language and control IDs the InfoSec team usually needs.

BAA considerations
- Our legal team reviewed the BAA draft. The retention clause you requested (7 years) is acceptable with one ask: we need to add a section that describes deletion verification steps (we propose a signed deletion certificate from the ops team for any de-provisioning). If Haven agrees, we can update the draft and prepare for signature.

Private VPC / On-prem feasibility (Karthik)
- Karthik provided an initial feasibility bullet list: Private VPC in Azure/AWS is straightforward; on-prem introduces additional packaging and an estimated 8–10 week integration window for pilot (includes validation, connectivity testing, and audit evidence collection). For Dedicated capacity with BAA, onboarding is ~2–3 weeks. Karthik, please confirm timeline for a minimal pilot install (we recommended a single model + endpoint).

Proposed next steps
1) Marissa: send updated BAA (BAA v1.1) with deletion verification language — target Mon 10:00 PT.
2) Karthik: one-page feasibility note for Private on-prem and a 2-week Dedicated onboarding checklist — target Mon EOD.
3) Schedule the security deep-dive (Marissa to confirm slot once Haven replies).

Attachments: SOC2-KMS-annotated-summary.pdf, Redwood-BAA-v1.1-diff.docx, infra-feasibility-bullets.pdf
